name: Altera
source:
This mysterious woman is one of the main characters of Fate/Extella.

[spoiler] She is know on Earth as Attila the Hun, but she really is this woman. She really is an extraterrestrial sent to attack Earth before an invasion by a her species. In the ancient past she killed the Roman god Mars and claimed his sword.[/spoiler]
